name: Helpdesk emails from an activity list
summary: Three flows that email the requester when a ticket is created, the technician when it is assigned, and the requester when its status changes, it is resolved or commented on.
capabilities: Starts on a new row of the activity list, filtered by event type with a trigger condition
Skips the email when the person made the change themselves
Sends as a shared mailbox when one is set
A mail override sends every message to one tester mailbox in Dev and Test
HTML-encodes ticket text before it goes into the body
configuration: ith-style environment variables: site, ticket list, activity list, notification mailbox, app link, mail override
Connection references for SharePoint and Outlook
notes: The generator writes all three flows (solution/src/Workflows/Notify*). Connector operation IDs and parameter names were written without a tenant and must be confirmed in the designer after import. Not yet run on a tenant.
